fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this suggestion-use event belongs to.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped).
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The source Excel row number (= source_row_number) the suggestion was used on.
fields.label: Excel Row

fields.description: The rate cell's Excel column letter (durable address).
fields.label: Col

fields.description: The rate-kind token of the used cell (e.g. supply_rate / install_rate / combined_rate).
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The helper that produced the suggestion (e.g. 'stub_pricing_sheet' / the real pricing-sheet helper id).
fields.label: Helper Id

fields.description: The resolved category id of the row at use time (e.g. wiring_cabling).
fields.label: Category Id

fields.description: The BoQ Rate Suggestion Run.run_id the used value came from. Joins a Use event back to its run.
fields.label: Run Id

fields.description: The AI-extracted attributes for the row (id -> value), as they stood when the value was used. JSON.
fields.label: Extracted Attributes

fields.description: The attributes AFTER any manual correction in the panel (id -> value). Equals extracted_attributes when the pricer did not edit. JSON -- the telemetry that measures extraction accuracy.
fields.label: Corrected Attributes

fields.description: The value the interpreter computed from the (possibly corrected) attributes.
fields.label: Computed Value

fields.description: The value actually written to the cell (= computed_value unless the pricer typed a manual final override).
fields.label: Used Value

fields.description: Who used the suggestion (frappe.session.user). Named event_user (NOT user) -- 'user' is a PostgreSQL reserved keyword.
fields.label: Event User

fields.description: When the suggestion was used. Set by the write endpoint.
fields.label: Used At
